products.title: Fibre Mood x MoMu Pack
products.body: The Fibre Mood x MoMu Collector’s Box Pack brings together all 6 exclusive sewing patterns from the Fibre Mood x MoMu Antwerp collection in one beautiful bundle: Sansa, Jon, Jak, Loren, Lucy and Mildred. Each pattern comes in its own numbered collector’s box, featuring the printed sewing pattern, illustrated instructions, and the story behind the design. A unique collection celebrating fashion, craftsmanship and Belgian heritage in a contemporary way. A special set for sewing enthusiasts, collectors and anyone who loves a little piece of fashion history.

products.title: Fibre Mood x MoMu: Lucy
products.body: This product is part of the exclusive Fibre Mood x MoMu collection, created in collaboration with MoMu (Fashion Museum Antwerp), as part of the European REEVALUATE project. Exclusive sewing pattern inspired by a piece from the MoMu collection Printed pattern and illustrated step-by-step instructions Packed in a numbered collector’s box with photography and the story behind the design Lucy is a feminine jacket with a relaxed fit, soft shape and distinctive vintage-inspired details. Based on a 1930s silk bed jacket from the MoMu collection, it brings a touch of old school glamour to a modern wardrobe.

products.title: Marwi Coat Sewing Pattern
products.body: One coat, two looks? Marwi makes it happen. This reversible coat can be worn either way around, making it perfect for those who like a bit of variety. The long, elegant cut and wide shawl collar create a timeless look, while the tie belt beautifully accentuates your silhouette. Thanks to the side pockets, Marwi is just as practical as it is stylish. Twice the wearing pleasure, without taking up any extra space in your wardrobe. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 56 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages projector file

products.title: Mingus Coat Sewing Pattern
products.body: Mingus is a coat that will surprise you in more ways than one. The straight front panel flows into a generous scarf that you can drape casually around your neck for a cosy, elegant look. With the matching belt, you can cinch the coat at the waist and decide for yourself how loose or fitted you want to wear it. The detachable sleeves offer extra versatility: with just a few buttons, you can transform Mingus into a sleeveless version in an instant. A coat, a duster and a scarf all in one – Mingus has it all. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 129 pages A0 / US format: 8 pages projector file

products.title: Nigel Jacket Sewing Pattern
products.body: This jacket makes the most of volume and surprising details. The hood extends down at the front, allowing you to tie the ends or wear them loose like a scarf. The wide sleeves give the design a relaxed look, while a sleeve flap with snap buttons makes you adjust them. You have handy zipped pockets in the side seams. Practical, comfortable and just that little bit different. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 73 pages A0 / US format: 4 pages projector file

products.title: Ria Skirt Sewing Pattern
products.body: This asymmetric skirt is all about a surprising interplay of lines. The slanted hem and front slit add movement and give the design its distinctive silhouette. At the back, the flap adds a subtle trench coat vibe to the design. An invisible zipper ensures a clean finish and keeps all the attention on the unique cut. A skirt that looks different from every angle. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 86 pages A0 / US format: 5 pages projector file

products.title: Herman Blazer Sewing Pattern
products.body: This oversized blazer makes a statement with ease. The straight, rectangular cut is given extra structure by the shoulder pads, while the slits in the side seams add a casual touch. The centre-front and centre-back seams add character to the silhouette, with a pocket subtly incorporated into the front seam. Buttons provide a classic fastening and are repeated at the slits in the sleeves. A blazer with a bold look that you can style for both chic and casual occasions. Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU) 0 - 28 (US) 4 - 32 (UK) A4 / Letter: 74 pages A0 / US format: 4 pages projector file

products.title: Jerom Coat Sewing Pattern
products.body: Jerom is a straight, long coat that combines simplicity with eye-catching details. The deep, wide neckline at the front gives the design a casual look, while the back neckline sits nicely high. Two snap buttons at the neck fasten the coat in a subtle way and allow it to fall loosely open. The pockets extend into the side seam and are beautifully integrated into the design. The strips on the front and back panels add extra character: sew them in a contrasting fabric or colour and give Jerom your very own twist. A simple coat with just that little bit extra. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 94 pages A0 / US format: 5 pages projector file

products.title: Louisa Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: Louisa is a flowing dress with a romantic twist and a surprising back detail. Go for the long version for an elegant, striking look, or choose the short version for a lighter, more playful look. The gathers at the front give the skirt lovely volume, while a large pleat at the back adds extra movement. The delicate, adjustable shoulder straps continue around the back and play a key role in the striking bow. There are buttonholes at the bottom of the straps and buttons on the bow, which you use to fasten the bow to the straps and keep it in place. A playful detail that turns the open back into a real eye-catcher. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 55 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages projector file

products.title: Magnus Sweater Sewing Pattern
products.body: Magnus is the sort of garment that effortlessly straddles the line between a sweater and a jacket. How to wear it? That’s up to you! The high, wide, straight collar creates a cosy look, while the raglan sleeves give the whole piece a relaxed feel. The long, 2-way zip runs from the collar right down to the hem and has two sliders so that you can wear it as you please. Zip Magnus right up for extra warmth, leave it slightly open at the top, or play around with an opening at the bottom for a more laid-back look. Comfortable, versatile and all set for cold days. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: pages A0 / US format: pages projector file

products.title: Eddie Hat Sewing Pattern
products.body: Eddie gives the classic bucket hat a surprising makeover. The extra-long brim creates a striking silhouette, and thanks to the casing with iron wire, you can shape the brim exactly as you like. Pressed down neatly, playfully folded or with your own twist? You decide the look. Small in size, big on style. Sizes: One Size A4 / Letter: 9 pages A0 / US format: 1 pages projector file

products.title: Elda Coat Sewing Pattern
products.body: This oversized coat makes a statement with its striking volume and graphic lines. The large collar fastens with a single button, instantly giving the design its character. The side seams run diagonally towards the front, while the seams on the front panel run diagonally towards the side seams, creating a surprising interplay of lines. At the back, a high centre-back split runs diagonally towards the side seams. The sleeves feature zipped pockets, an unexpected detail that gives the design an extra rugged touch. Pockets in the side seams complete the look. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 97 pages A0 / US format: 5 pages projector file

products.title: Elof Jacket Sewing Pattern
products.body: Vest? Cape? Why choose when Elof combines the best of both? This sleeveless jacket is designed to be worn in layers and instantly gives any outfit a contemporary twist. The zip, elasticated hem and belted collar create a cool look, while the two slanted pockets and chest pocket make it extra practical. A versatile must-sew that can be worn effortlessly over a jumper, shirt or even a coat. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 58 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages projector file

products.title: Gio Gloves Sewing Pattern
products.body: Stylish, practical and perfect for crisp autumn days: Gio is the glove you’ll want to have on hand as soon as the temperatures start to drop. Thanks to the two casings with elastic cord and cord stoppers, you can easily pull Gio up and adjust it to your liking. The thumb hole ensures your hands stay nice and warm, while your fingers can move freely. Perfect for a brisk autumn walk, an evening around the campfire or simply to add that extra cosy touch to your outdoor look. Sizes: S - L A4 / Letter: 9 pages A0 / US format: 1 pages projector file

products.title: Aki Shirt Sewing Pattern
products.body: Aki is the kind of shirt you can mix and match endlessly. Wear it loose for a relaxed look or accentuate your waist with the matching belt – it’s up to you. The simple straight collar and cuffs give it a timeless look, while the pleats and the two-piece front panel add extra character. The generously rounded hem gives Aki a lovely, flowing drape, and the slits in the sleeves add the perfect finishing touch. Finish it off with double topstitching for a subtle utility touch. Casual chic has never been so easy. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 50 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages projector file

products.title: Anette Jacket Sewing Pattern
products.body: Large lapels, cosy vibes and plenty of character: Anette effortlessly steals the show. The striking lapels extend right down to the waist, giving the coat a powerful look. The elasticated hem creates a lovely rounded silhouette that’s wonderfully comfortable to wear. And then there are the side pockets, cleverly incorporated as a casing on the inside of the coat. Practical, surprising and absolutely set to become your favourite autumn layer. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 63 pages A0 / US format: 4 pages projector file

products.title: Boaz Skirt Sewing Pattern
products.body: Pleats, comfort and a touch of cool: Boaz has it all. The deep pleats create a lovely, roomy fit that moves beautifully with you, whilst the elasticated waistband with a drawstring ensures extra comfort. Made from a water-repellent fabric, even a typical autumn shower won’t stop you. Rain on the way? Boaz just carries on as usual. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 41 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages projector file

products.title: Dante Jacket Sewing Pattern
products.body: Dante proves that a bomber jacket doesn’t have to be basic at all. The pleats at the front and back panel create a lovely rounded silhouette, while the voluminous sleeves with elasticated cuffs make an extra statement. The small collar and concealed button placket keep the whole look sleek and modern. Sporty with a fashion twist – or how a bomber jacket effortlessly takes centre stage in your outfit. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 69 pages A0 / US format: 4 pages projector file

products.title: Pattern Book Special n°5
products.body: Fibre Mood Special n°5 invites you to head outdoors, breathe in the crisp autumn air, and enjoy the warmth of good company. This Outdoor Special is packed with cosy patterns full of character for the colder season: from jackets, coats and blazers to sweaters, skirts, dresses and versatile layering pieces. Accessories haven’t been forgotten either, with a bucket hat and warm gloves to complete your outdoor look. Expect generous volumes, strong silhouettes, and clever details that effortlessly combine comfort and style. Think faux fur, faux leather, suede, animal prints and a rich colour palette inspired by caramel, chocolate and gold. Anette and Dante make a statement with their oversized silhouettes, while Elof, Magnus and Mingus offer endless possibilities for layering. Each design brings

products.title: Baba pattern bundle
products.body: A little one on the way? Time to make something special! The Baba Pattern Pack brings together 6 adorable and versatile patterns for babies aged 0 to 18 months. From comfy basics to a lovely sweater dress, each design is perfect for mixing and matching and making entirely your own. And you’ll get the Sammy knitting pattern for free! With the right fabric choice, you can easily give every design a cool, playful or extra-cute look. The pack includes: Otis : A loose-fitting T-shirt with grown-on sleeves, a polo fastening and chest pocket, a versatile basic for little adventurers. Blake : Comfortable skinny trousers with turn-ups, perfect for little legs and fully nappy friendly. Celia : A lovely sweater dress with playful ruffles and a handy button fastening at the shoulder. Charlie : An airy

products.title: Look of the Season: Autumn
products.body: Ready for rainy days? With Martha, Kiva and Blaze, you’ve got the perfect autumn look covered. Throw the roomy Martha trench coat over any outfit, pair it with Kiva for a fresh, contemporary pair of trousers with a perfect fit, and add Blaze, the comfortable long-sleeve top that works perfectly underneath. Three technically strong patterns that come together to create a practical, stylish and comfortable autumn wardrobe. This bundle includes: Martha , Kiva & Blaze .

products.title: Lucy Jacket Sewing Pattern (Fibre Mood x MoMu)
products.body: This pattern was created as part of the European REEVALUATE project in collaboration with MoMu Antwerp. From 1930s jacket to contemporary raglan jacket: Lucy is a relaxed, collarless jacket with an elegant 1930s feel. The loose fit and raglan sleeves create a fluid silhouette, while the V-shaped neckline, front pockets and button fastening add a modern, versatile twist. Inspired by a beige silk jacket from the 1930s, Lucy is designed to be effortlessly wearable today, from casual to dressed-up. Sizes: XS-XXXL

products.title: Mildred Dress Sewing Pattern (Fibre Mood x MoMu)
products.body: This pattern was created as part of the European REEVALUATE project in collaboration with MoMu Antwerp. From 1920s evening dress to contemporary statement dress: Mildred is a sleeveless dress with a straight silhouette and an elegant asymmetrical cut. The V-neckline at the front and back and the bias-cut insert give the design a refined, graphic look, while the bust darts ensure a flattering fit. Fully lined and with no fastening, the dress is surprisingly easy to slip on. Inspired by a 1920s evening dress, Mildred captures the spirit of the original in a contemporary and accessible pattern. Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU) 0 - 28 (US) 4 - 32 (UK)

products.title: Kit Dress Sewing Pattern (Fibre Mood x MoMu)
products.body: This pattern was created as part of the European REEVALUATE project in collaboration with MoMu Antwerp. From regional bodice to architectural dress: Kit translates the distinctive lines of an 18th-century bodice from the Zaanstreek region into a striking contemporary dress. The fitted bodice with a round neckline and tie fastening at the back creates a strong contrast with the full, voluminous skirt. Two large layers of fabric add extra volume and movement, while the front darts subtly echo the square lines of the historical bodice. A dress that plays with proportion, volume and a touch of historical flair. Sizes: XS - XXXL

products.title: Loren Kimono Sewing Pattern (Fibre Mood x MoMu)
products.body: This pattern was created as part of the European REEVALUATE project in collaboration with MoMu Antwerp. From painted kimono to contemporary interpretation: Loren draws inspiration from a traditional Japanese furisode, translating its distinctive long, flowing sleeves and rich patterns into a contemporary silhouette. The contrasting rever collar and double front pockets add a modern, functional twist, while the diagonal lines at the back accentuate the waist. The traditionally flat kimono silhouette is given more shape and structure, creating a unique design where Japanese tradition meets contemporary fashion. Sizes: XS - XXXL

products.title: Jon Bermuda Sewing Pattern (Fibre Mood x MoMu)
products.body: This pattern was created as part of the European REEVALUATE project in collaboration with MoMu Antwerp. From bloomers to pleated trousers: Jon is a statement pair of trousers that plays with volume and movement. Deep pleats at the front and back create an almost skirt-like silhouette that shifts with every step. The high, structured waistband and straight hems give the design a modern, tailored look, while the wide legs ensure a surprisingly comfortable fit. Inspired by black wool cycling knickers from the late 19th century, Jon transforms a historical functional garment into a bold contemporary design. Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU) 0 - 28 (US) 4 - 32 (UK)

products.title: Sansa Blouse Sewing Pattern (Fibre Mood x MoMu)
products.body: This pattern was created as part of the European REEVALUATE project in collaboration with MoMu Antwerp. From cycling blouse to sculptural blouse: Sansa is a statement blouse where volume and movement take centre stage. Large pleats at the shoulders and sleeve caps create a sculptural silhouette, while the pleated bow detail at the back adds a playful touch. Long, wide ties at the hem accentuate the waist and allow you to adjust the silhouette to your liking. Inspired by a white cotton cycling blouse from the late 19th century, but fully reimagined as a contemporary statement blouse. Sizes: XS - XXXL

products.title: Transitional pack: editions 30, 35, 36, 37 and SP1
products.body: Warm summer days, crisp mornings and a new season just around the corner? The in between season calls for smart outfit choices. And that's exactly where our Transitional Pack comes in. With 5 magazines full of sewing inspiration, you'll be ready for the transition into autumn. This versatile selection includes everything from breezy summer pieces and stylish layering essentials to timeless autumn garments and cosy winter favourites. Whatever the weather, you'll always have the perfect sewing projects at your fingertips.

products.title: Pyjama Chic sewing pattern (Fibre Mood x JULIANA MARTEJEVS)
products.body: Meet the ultimate sleepwear trio: Serena, Lana & Aurora. Serena is a chic pajama blouse with elegant tailoring details, Lana a comfortable pajama pant with an elastic waistband and practical side pockets, and Aurora the matching sleep mask that adds the perfect finishing touch. Sew them together as a coordinated pajama set or mix and match the pieces to create loungewear you'll want to wear far beyond the bedroom. From cozy flannel and soft cotton to luxurious satin and silk-look fabrics, this ensemble combines comfort, style, and dreamy elegance in every stitch. Serena Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 45 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages projector file Lana Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 40 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages projector file Aurora Sizes: One Size

products.title: Pattern bundle: Nori + Yuna
products.body: Two patterns, one perfect pairing! Meet Yuna, a modern pencil skirt with a stylish twist, and Nori, a workwear-inspired jacket. Wear them together or mix and match them with your favourite wardrobe staples. Get both patterns in one bundle and save on the digital patterns!

products.title: Zafira Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: Fancy a fun sewing challenge? Then why not add Zafira to your to-sew list. It’s a project that requires quite a lot of fabric, but the result is well worth it. This long dress features voluminous, gathered sections in the skirt and has a casing at the front, creating a blouson effect. The ties at the collar beautifully tie together the neckline at the front, and Zafira’s sleeves are finished with a slit and a cuff. Grand, flowing and made to turn heads. products.body: Fancy a fresh take on the classic pencil skirt? Meet Yuna! With its loose front panel, back slit and neatly finished waistband with facing, it proves that a classic doesn’t have to be boring and is sure to earn a place in your wardrobe. Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU) 0 - 28 (US) 4 - 32 (UK) A4 / Letter: 38 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages projector file

products.title: Veya Blouse Sewing Pattern
products.body: A blouse with character. Veya combines an oversized fit with surprising details, such as the slit at the front and the neck binding that continues down the centre back and is tied there. The sleeves with slits and cuffs, the front pocket and the yoke at the centre front of the neckline complete the look. Ready for some compliments? Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 50 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages projector file

products.body: Looking for a dress that’s just that little bit different? A surprising detail that gives this must-sew piece extra character. Otherwise, Umi keeps it simple, so you can style it any way you like. products.title: Sofora Bag Sewing Pattern
products.body: As if you needed another excuse to buy a new handbag... Sofora’s side panels flow into the shoulder straps, which are stitched together for a nicely finished look. This fully lined accessory can be worn in various ways: tie the shoulder straps at the top for a playful effect or leave them hanging loose for a more casual look. The hardest choice? That’ll be deciding how many different styles you want to create. Sizes: One Size A4 / Letter: 13 pages A0 / US format: 1 pages projector file

products.title: Sora Trousers Sewing Pattern
products.body: Barrel trousers remain a favourite, and Sora shows why. The panel seam at the front really emphasises the rounded silhouette, while the combination of front jeans pockets and patch pockets at the back creates a casual look. The details are spot on too: a yoke at the back and a waistband with belt loops give the trousers a neat finish. Wear Sora with sneakers for a casual look, or pair them with heels for an extra feminine look. Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU) 0 - 28 (US) 4 - 32 (UK) A4 / Letter: 47 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages projector file

products.title: Nori Jacket Sewing Pattern
products.body: Workwear, but with a delicate twist? Meet Nori: a cool jacket with sophisticated details. The welt pockets extend right down to the hem and are finished with decorative pocket flaps, while the zip is concealed behind a placket. The slightly larger collar and the sleeves, with a seam that slightly curves forwards, give Nori extra shape. And there’s even more: a yoke, rising seams at the back and double topstitching complete the rugged look. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 52 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages projector file

products.title: Kiva Trousers Sewing Pattern
products.body: Kiva has everything it takes to become a favourite and proves that comfort and style go hand in hand. Pleats at the waist, darts at the hem, slanted side pockets, belt loops and a fly with button closure: she’s got it all. Now all you have to do is decide whether to go for sneakers or heels. The rest will follow naturally. Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU) 0 - 28 (US) 4 - 32 (UK) A4 / Letter: 47 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages projector file

products.title: Niva Top Sewing Pattern
products.body: All eyes on Niva! Because sometimes a top can be just that little bit extra. With Niva, the elegant draping and pleats at the front take centre stage. The stand-up collar adds an extra touch of class, and the invisible zip at the centre back creates a beautifully sleek silhouette. The armholes are nicely finished with a facing. Do you have a party coming up, or do you simply fancy taking your everyday look to the next level? This must-sew piece feels at ease anywhere and adapts effortlessly to your plans. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 34 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages projector file

products.title: Leni Top Sewing Pattern
products.body: Leni is one of those tops that doesn’t demand attention, but still manages to get it. The raglan sleeves, the side panel, the neckline with facing and the vertical seams on the back give it that little bit extra. Pair it with your favourite jeans or turn it into a matching set. Just perfect for days when you don’t want to think too much, but still want to look stylish. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 24 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages projector file

products.title: Elva Blouse Sewing Pattern
products.body: A blouse you’ll be happy to make more than once, because Elva has plenty of lovely features in store. The elastic in the sleeves and hem adds extra volume, while the stand-up collar and a polo placket give it a bit of extra character. The tie in the underarm seam makes it easy to roll up the sleeves for a more casual look. And we haven’t even mentioned the optional scarf detail at the top button yet – as if Elva wasn’t charming enough already. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 51 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages projector file

products.title: Alya Blazer Sewing Pattern
products.body: A blazer with a slightly different twist. Alya keeps it sleek and simple, with a collarless design and welt pockets with a flap as a nod to the classic blazer. The slit at the centre back allows for extra freedom of movement and a lovely drape. Wear Alya open over a top or dress on cooler days, or pair her with trousers in the same fabric for an absolutely fantastic outfit. She won’t be left hanging on that coat rack for long! Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 42 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages projector file

products.title: Pattern Book 40
products.body: Fresh season, fresh inspiration. Fibre Mood 40 is the perfect way to kick off a new sewing season, featuring twelve brand-new patterns that effortlessly combine style, comfort, and versatility. Discover designs you'll enjoy making and love wearing for years to come, from timeless wardrobe staples with a modern twist to true statement pieces. Embrace modern tailoring with Alya, discover the bold character of Nori, or add a new favourite to your wardrobe with Sora, the barrel-leg trousers you'll style with everything. Elva, Leni, Niva, Umi, and Veya are the perfect essentials for a stylish transitional wardrobe, while Yuna, Kiva, and the flowing Zafira dress bring unexpected silhouettes and refined details. Complete your look with Sofora, a bag that's as practical as it is stylish. From the

products.title: Berto Jacket Sewing Pattern (Fibre Mood x Sewlukeivo)
products.body: Berto is an oversized, boxy jacket inspired by workwear, but with a playful twist. The visible facing pieces create deep front pockets and a sailor’s collar, combining practicality with a touch of character. Go for a classic look or experiment with contrasting fabrics and piping to give Berto your own personal twist. The perfect layering piece for the mid-season. Thanks to its unisex design, Berto fits seamlessly into any wardrobe. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 45 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages projector file

products.title: Storm Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: Summery, flowing and hassle-free: Storm is a loose, wide maxi dress with wide shoulder straps that drapes beautifully and moves effortlessly. The full length button closure at the centre front creates a subtle slit and allows you to play with styling. Side seam pockets make Storm extra practical, while the wide, topstitched hem ensures a sturdy, nicely finished look. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 48 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages projector file

products.title: Mina Shorts Sewing Pattern
products.body: Mina looks like a flouncy mini circle skirt, but is actually a light, playful pair of shorts. The elastic waistband with a tie threaded through buttonholes at the centre front ensures comfort and adds a lovely accent to the waist. You can make the tie yourself or opt for a ready-made version for a quick finish. Last but not least: side- seam pockets are always a bonus. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 32 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages projector file

products.title: Maris Top Sewing Pattern
products.body: Maris requires a bit of patience when sewing, but you’ll be rewarded with a light, playful top. The gathers at the front and back meet at the doubled yoke, creating volume and a neat inner finish that hides any fraying. The sleeve is given a touch of flair with gathers at the cuff and a slit. Other features: Maris has a hidden polo placket at the centre front, a neckline finished with bias tape, and a small slit in the side seam that makes styling extra flexible: tuck it in at the front and leave loose at the back, or however you want to wear it. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 37 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages projector file

products.title: Laleh Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: Laleh makes an effortless statement. The tailored fit with a deep neckline at both the front and back immediately sets the tone for this elegant dress, where bust darts ensure a nice fit without compromising on comfort. The invisible zip in the side seam creates a sleek, minimalist finish, while the slit in the back adds elegant freedom of movement with every step. One dress, endless style. Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU) 0 - 28 (US) 4 - 32 (UK) A4 / Letter: 38 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages projector file

products.title: Kiri Top Sewing Pattern
products.body: Kiri is the kind of top you can whip up in no time and then wear non-stop. The draping and waterfall effect take centre stage in this halter top with a stand-up collar, but the asymmetrical hem at the centre front adds a lovely little touch. All edges are finished with bias tape, and at the back, Kiri fastens at the nape of the neck with buttons and elastic loops for comfort and ease of wear. Did we mention that this minimalist design has a real wow factor? Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 26 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages projector file

products.title: Kaori Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: Kaori is perfect for long summer days and even longer summer evenings. This long, flowing dress with raglan sleeves feels wonderfully airy, and has pleats in the sleeves for a subtle puffed effect and gathers at the back and sleeves for a playful touch. The deep neckline at the front features eyelets and a tie for a customisable look with character. The neckline is neatly finished with a facing, and handy pockets are hidden in the side seams. A dress that’s just as happy to accompany you on a walk to the beach as it is to a terrace on a balmy summer evening. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 51 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages projector file

products.title: Josse Trousers Sewing Pattern
products.body: Josse offers instant comfort with a playful twist. These harem trousers with a dropped crotch have a wonderfully loose fit, with gathers at the waist and ankles that create a soft, relaxed silhouette. The waist is elasticated and finished with an extra tie on the inside for an adjustable fit. The slits with a crossed fastening at the ankles let you choose how tight or loose you wear the trousers. You set the tone, Josse follows. Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU) 0 - 28 (US) 4 - 32 (UK) A4 / Letter: 45 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages projector file

products.title: Frankie Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: Frankie keeps things sleek and well-designed. This tailored mini dress with a boat neck owes its flattering fit to bust and waist darts at the front and back. The button closure at the centre front is partly decorative: you slip it on via an invisible zip in the side seam and only use the top two buttons (fewer buttonholes, more sewing fun!). Frankie’s neckline and armholes are finished with a facing, and the welt pockets on the front give the design a refined finishing touch. Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU) 0 - 28 (US) 4 - 32 (UK) A4 / Letter: 33 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages projector file

products.title: Elinor Top Sewing Pattern
products.body: Elinor immediately catches the eye with its asymmetrical cut and draped twist detail on the left shoulder, creating a bold, sculptural silhouette. The top is fully lined and neatly finished at the neckline and armholes, creating a playful bubble hem. The elastic in the hem enhances that balloon effect and brings the draping to life beautifully. A statement piece that is also very wearable. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 61 pages A0 / US format: 4 pages projector file

products.title: Nico Bag Sewing Pattern
products.body: Nico is the bag you’ll take with you everywhere. Large, practical and ready for whatever the day brings. Thanks to the extra storage space on the outside – with a pocket on either side of the central compartment – you’ll always have your essentials within easy reach. Practical, spacious and ready for every day: just pack it up and go. Sizes: One Size A4 / Letter: 20 pages A0 / US format: 1 pages projector file

products.title: Amaya Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: Sun on your skin, sand between your toes… and Amaya draped loosely over your outfit. That’s all you need. Amaya is a light, sleeveless dress that you wear loosely over trousers, shorts or a skirt. Thanks to the two sets of ties, the dress is closed only at the top and flutters open playfully at the front. The delicate spaghetti straps with bra rings and sliders make it easy to adjust to the right length, whilst the bust darts on the front ensure a flattering fit. Amaya’s neckline and armholes are neatly finished with a facing for a polished look, inside and out. Ready for sun, sea and everything in between. Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU) 0 - 28 (US) 4 - 32 (UK) A4 / Letter: 45 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages projector file

products.title: Pattern Bundle: Fibre Move ED 39
products.body: Combine the Zoey top with beautiful crochet and macrame eye-catchers like Malvin, Lily and Olga. This bundle includes: the Zoey top, the Lilly clutch, Tia shopper, Malvin Macrame bag and the Olga earrings"

products.title: Jax Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: Jax is perfect for carefree summer days with its loose and breezy fit. This flowing maxi dress with a gathered neckline and dropped waist is given extra movement by the gathers at the dividing seam, creating a supple, flattering silhouette. No fastenings required: you tie Jax closed with a tie through the casing at the neckline. And last but not least: the open back lets the sun kiss your skin, making this dress totally summer-ready. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 38 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages projector file

products.title: Pattern Book 39
products.body: Fibre Mood 39 invites you to slow down. This edition is all about soft silhouettes and garments that feel light, move freely and bring a sense of calm. Think boho influences, natural materials, dreamy volumes and details that effortlessly combine comfort and elegance. Let yourself be carried away by flowy dresses like Jax, Kaori and Storm, designed for warm days and long summer evenings. Amaya adds a lightweight layer that drapes effortlessly over any outfit, while Laleh stands out with its simple, feminine lines. Frankie gives the classic mini dress a clean, modern look, and Elinor plays with sculptural shapes and asymmetric details. Josse brings comfort and character in a playful, relaxed fit. Mina may look like a swishy skirt but is wonderfully practical to wear as shorts, and Kiri prov

products.body: The Fibre Mood Essentials Pack brings together 9 all-time favourite sewing patterns in one beautifully curated bundle. Each essential comes individually packaged in a stylish box, complete with the printed sewing pattern and detailed printed instructions. Ready to inspire your customers from the very first stitch. This carefully selected collection features timeless wardrobe staples that belong in every closet: the Gizeh trousers, Lucia bermuda shorts, Gina T-shirt, Yuka top, and Hylda turtleneck. The bundle also includes the elegant Carry blouse, cosy Lara sweater, stylish Judith jacket, and the versatile Tempest skirt. The Essentials Pack is an affordable and attractive way to offer your customers a complete set of must-sew basics. Perfect as a giftable item or an eye-catching addition t

products.title: Olga Macrame Earrings Pattern
products.body: Make your boho festival outfit complete with these cute macrame earrings. You make these up so fast you’ll want a pair in every color.

products.title: Malvin Bag Macrame Pattern
products.body: The fishnet bag is an ever-trending must-have. It’s versatile, perfect for small shopping trips or a day at the beach.

products.title: B2B Subscription

Pay per edition or per year , with a great discount when you opt for annual payment. Everything runs automatically : you no longer need to manually check out your cart or keep track of release dates. Multiple subscriptions at once : ideal if you want magazines in different languages or delivered to multiple addresses. Delivery to your home or store , exactly how you want it.

products.title: Zoey Top Sewing Pattern
products.body: Zoey is an almost zero-waste top that proves simplicity is anything but boring. This cropped top, featuring grown-on, wide sleeves and a boat neck, finished with bias tape, has a minimalist look with a modern twist. A fun, quick project, ideal for finally digging out those lovely scraps from your fabric stash and turning them into something beautiful.

products.title: Yara Blouse Sewing Pattern
products.body: Yara is a flowing blouse that instantly adds a festive touch to your outfit. The various ruffles create a playful, feminine effect, and you can choose between a two- or three-ruffled version, depending on how bold you want to go. It has all the typical features of a blouse:a collar with a collar stand, a button placket, narrow cuffs, and a chest pocket. The sleeves flare out towards the bottom and feature a subtle cutout, giving them an extra airy and flowing drape. The slits in the side seams make the garment even looser and more comfortable. Yara is ready for any summer party, or just for a weekday with a bit of extra flair.

products.title: Tindra Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: Tindra is a shirtdress that effortlessly blends chic and casual. It features a hidden button closure in centre front, patch pockets with flaps on the front and a collar with a collar stand for that timeless blouse look. The wide, long statement sleeves are finished with a high, wide cuff. Thanks to the pleats in the back and side seam, Tindra features a lovely, fitted waistline and a subtle blouson effect on the bodice. The skirt falls loosely around the hips, creating an elegant, relaxed fit.

products.title: Rima Blouse Sewing Pattern
products.body: Rima is a sleeveless blouse with a subtle charm. The armhole darts ensure a flattering fit, and the neckline with its tie adds a playful, feminine touch. Bonus points for the cute little cape, which gives Rima that extra something, but can also be left out easily.

products.title: Maela Top Sewing Pattern
products.body: Maela is a cool, sleeveless top with a ribbed neckband and hem band: a simple summer project that’s fun to make in different variations. It was designed for knitted fabrics, so if you do opt for a woven fabric, please keep in mind that you’ll need to finish the neckband and hem band in rib knit. We created a see-through version in a fishnet fabric: thanks to its neat finish, the top looks fantastic both on the outside and the inside, making it ideal for sheer fabrics. Pair it with the Sylva bralette and you’re all set for a sunny day.

products.title: Sylva Top Sewing Pattern
products.body: Sylva is the perfect bralette to wear under sheer or openwork garments. The darts ensure a contoured fit, whilst the elasticated fastening at the back makes it easy to adjust to your band size. Pair it with Maela in fishnet or with Lumen in a sheer fabric for a stylish, sophisticated look. Or wear Sylva with a co-ord set made from a similar fabric, such as Tasha and Tesni or Dahlia and Libbie. Comfortable, flattering, and made to be seen.

products.title: Lumen Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: Lumen is one of those pieces that effortlessly exudes class.This sleeveless dress with a short, stand-up collar has a slightly fitted cut that flatters your figure whilst remaining wonderfully comfortable. The slit at the centre back allows for extra freedom of movement and adds a subtle finishing touch. Not in the mood for dresses? You can also sew Lumen as a top: just as stylish, just as versatile. Fancy making a statement in tulle or another sheer fabric? An additional set of instructions is available online. A little more challenging to finish neatly, but clearly explained step by step. Statement piece incoming!

products.title: Luki Trousers Sewing Pattern
products.body: Playful, versatile and just that little bit different: meet Luki, the trousers that instantly add interest to your outfit thanks to the insert in the side seam. You can create a pleat at the hem for extra volume (with a hem facing) or leave the insert open for a loose, wide-leg look and finish the hem without a facing. You can wear Luki as a pair of trousers or knee-length Bermuda shorts, depending on the season or your mood. Key features: a shaped waistband, front side pockets, patch pockets at the back, belt loops and a centre-front zip fly.

products.title: Isola Top Sewing Pattern
products.body: This top may look simple, but it makes a big impact. The pleats are stitched into place, creating a subtle peplum effect: it fits snugly at the top and flares gently towards the hem. It’s incredibly flattering and wonderfully airy on hot summer days. Isola features a round neckline, and both the neckline and armholes are finished with a separate set-in collar for a neat, refined look. You fasten the top with a sew-on snap on the neckband at centre back. Elegant with a playful twist? Sounds like Isola!

products.title: Evin Jacket Sewing Pattern
products.body: Evin is the perfect jacket for anyone who loves a bold look with a romantic touch. The stand-up collar, centre front button closure, and flaps on both collar and sleeves give this cropped design a powerful utilitarian look, while the gathers on the front and back - sewn onto a flat piece - provide that soft, feminine contrast. Thanks to the flaps, you can roll up the wide sleeves for a casual look. There is a piped pocket at the front, which you can omit if you wish to simplify the project. An added bonus: Evin is unlined, which reduces the level of difficulty. In short: it’s a statement piece that is surprisingly easy to sew and it will perfectly into your mid-season wardrobe.

products.title: Bryn Top Sewing Pattern
products.body: Bryn is one of those tops that instantly adds something extra to your outfit. This asymmetrical wrap top with a boat neck subtly plays with lines and creates an elegant, modern look: minimal with a twist. A wrap and frill effect is created around the waist, which is very flattering for a variety of silhouettes. The ¾ sleeves give Bryn the versatility you're looking for on summer days and evenings, and the slits in the side seam add that extra bit of movement. The best part? No fuss with fastenings. Just slip it on and you're ready to go. Easy, effortless and oh so chic.

products.title: Angela Trousers Sewing Pattern
products.body: Angela really proves that less is more. These clean, simple balloon trousers with a fly and zip are the ultimate summer essential with personality. The subtly rounded legs create a trendy, statement silhouette, whilst the darts in the back ensure a flattering fit. The waistline is finished with a facing for a sleek look. And of course: handy pockets in the side seams, because style can also be practical. Pair them with a cropped top, a light blouse or a fitted tank top, and you’re instantly ready for summer. Simple, stylish, Angela.

products.title: Pattern bundle: Fibre Move
products.body: 3 strong Fibre Mood patterns in one great-value bundle: Cyrille, Barbro and Perry. Perfect basics to mix, match, and reinterpret endlessly. Create a contemporary, sporty chic look by using Perry as a base and reshaping the legs into Barbro’s signature barrel silhouette. Pair with Cyrille for a comfortable, on-trend outfit. Cyrille (FM 35) : an oversized sweater with a relaxed, modern fit Barbro (FM 37) : a statement pair of trousers with a trendy barrel silhouette Perry (FM 35) : comfortable sweatpants with a timeless fit Go for comfort style, and join the #fibremove.

products.title: Pattern Book 38
products.body: Fibre Mood 38 is all about celebration. This edition is bursting with energy, optimism, and creative freedom, featuring bold colours, playful details, and silhouettes that are meant to stand out. From sparkling accents to unexpected shapes and subtle design twists, Fibre Mood 38 invites you to celebrate DIY fashion and let your personal style shine. Discover patterns that feel festive yet practical. Angela and Luki give classic trousers a modern twist, while Bryn and Isola explore lines, pleats, and asymmetry. Lumen and Tindra bring elegant statement pieces that feel both polished and relaxed, and Yara adds a playful touch with her ruffles. Meanwhile, Evin, Rima, and Zoey show that thoughtful details and clever cuts are all it takes to make an outfit something special, while Maela and Sylv

products.title: Pattern Bundle: City Trip
products.body: Planning a city trip? With our city trip pattern bundle, you get 5 must-sew city trip pieces at an extra special price. Discover them all and get ready for an unforgettable trip. Cruz : From cozy coffee bars to city strolls, Cruz is the essential layer with a sporty yet refined edge. Nousha : Stay organized with Nousha, the bag that keeps your essentials close and your outfit on point. Abby : Whatever the weather, Abby keeps you dry and stylish while you explore the city carefree. Allie : The comfy jeans made for long days of wandering through the city, shops, and hidden spots. Yuka : Wear Yuka as a dress or style it as a top: your versatile favorite for sunny days and effortless city looks.

products.title: Pattern Book 36
products.body: Wrap it up with Fibre Mood 36! The festive season is approaching, the perfect time to get creative. Be inspired by surprising textures, frivolous details and integrated accessories and end the year in style. In the final sprint of the year, enjoy relaxation and fun in creating: think of comfortable silhouettes with a touch of elegance. Fluffy volumes and warm tones make every outfit winter-proof. From Avina's modern corset to Milena's elegant twist: in Fibre Mood 36, you will find everything you need to celebrate the year in style. Warm, winter-proof coats such as Esme, Fiora and Inga keep you cosy, while Greta, Mireya and Ivanna stimulate your creativity with special details and playful silhouettes. Sofia is the cosy essential for cold days, and Samira and Zizou provide elegant looks for

products.title: Pattern Book 37
products.body: Fibre Mood 37 is all about shape, bringing a fresh spring energy to your DIY wardrobe. From balloon sleeves and rounded legs to asymmetric cuts and unexpected details, this spring edition puts the silhouette centre stage, while leaving plenty of room for your own interpretation, fabric choices, and personal style. Discover statement pieces such as the oversized Astrid jacket with its balloon hem, the bold Barbro barrel-leg jeans, and Jacoba, a blazer featuring an elegant open neckline and sculptural sleeves. Softer shapes and clever contrasts come together in Caren and Ola, while asymmetry takes the lead in Kornelia and Willow. products.title: Pattern Bundle: Female Power
products.body: The Female Power Bundle celebrates women who move through life with confidence, care and intention. Women who know their strength and support each other along the way. This bundle brings together patterns that are designed to move with you, not shape you. Pieces that feel comfortable yet powerful, effortless yet expressive. Clothing that supports your everyday life and reminds you that strength and softness can exist side by side. Pair the Naima trousers with the loose-fitting Joni blazer for a strong everyday look. Add the Tiany top for a casual vibe or switch to the Risa blouse when you’re in the mood for something more refined. products.title: Pattern Bundle: Sunday Chill
products.body: Tired of party clothes? Time to relax! Our Sunday Chill pattern bundle contains 5 stylish patterns that together create the perfect outfit for the ultimate lazy days. Comfortable and trendy, ideal for both relaxing indoors and casual outings. The bundle contains: The bundle contains: Mika : The perfect all-rounder jumper, easy to combine and always comfortable Raya : A cozy cardigan that keeps you nice and warm on cooler days Perry : Comfy, loose-fitting trousers that move effortlessly with you Erica : The ultimate casual T-shirt, simple and stylish Afra : A T-shirt with a boat neck, for when your outfit needs to be a little more special

products.title: Liverpool Street Belt Sewing Pattern (Fibre Mood x Eva Schalckens)
products.body: Add a unique touch to your outfit with this Japanese-inspired belt without a buckle. This sewing pattern invites you to play with fabric scraps and turn them into a personal work of art. Let your creativity run free and give small pieces of fabric a second life. * For the sizing guide and information about the materials, please download the instructions.

products.title: Leicester Square Stole Sewing Pattern (Fibre Mood x Eva Schalckens)
products.body: Give your outfit an elegant upgrade with this versatile stole or scarf. It’s perfect to drape over your shoulders on cooler evenings, or to make a bold statement over a coat or blazer. Pick your favorite fabrics and play around with colors and textures to create a piece that really suits you. That way, you’ll end up with an accessory that’s both practical and stylish and unique because you made it yourself. * For the sizing guide and information about the materials, please download the instructions.

products.title: Reya Top Sewing Pattern (Fibre Mood x Geri)
products.body: This pattern is part of our Fibre Mood collaborations. Together with Geri (@geri_in_stitches), we combined our creative forces to bring the Reya pattern to life. A festive, versatile top with a deep V-neckline and elegant raglan sleeves. And what makes it even more fun? You get to choose the look! Sleek and classy with the front insert, or delightfully romantic with tie ribbons, as many as you like! Sizes: XS - XXXL

products.title: Elmo Shawl Sewing Pattern
products.body: Elmo is perhaps this season's trendiest accessory. A padded scarf with an opening, designed for lightweight warmth and comfort on the coldest days. What's more, it's a quick and easy sewing project, so it's perfect for making multiple versions to keep out the cold in a smart and stylish way!

products.title: Samira Top Sewing Pattern
products.body: Samira is elegance in its simplest form. This flowy top has a stand-up collar and wide sleeves that create an airy, graceful look. The button closure is located on the collar at the centre back, and you can choose the number of buttons and their size – a fun detail to play with! Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 32 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages projector file

products.title: Sofia Sweater Sewing Pattern
products.body: Sofia is the roll neck jumper that no capsule wardrobe should be without and a real autumn essential. The raglan sleeves ensure a comfortable fit, while the wide, long sleeves give this must-sew a casual touch. Sofia is a quick project and therefore ideal for a last-minute trip or impulsive sewing moment. Warm, cosy and super timeless! Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 32 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages projector file

products.title: Ivanna Trousers Sewing Pattern
products.body: Ivanna is the perfect pair of trousers for those who love comfort and elegance. A wide-leg style with pleats at the front and back, a shaped waistband and handy belt loops for your favourite (matching) belt. Wear Ivanna with a chunky jumper for a casual-chic look or with an elegant blouse for a classy appearance. Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU) 0 - 28 (US) 4 - 32 (UK) A4 / Letter: 48 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages projector file

products.title: Mireya Skirt Sewing Pattern
products.body: A skirt with sleeves? Absolutely! Mireya features charming ties at the waist that double as sleeves, a playful trend this season. Looking for a more classic look? Then simply leave them out. We created this lined skirt at knee length, but you can adjust it to suit your preferences. Mireya has an elegant overlapping slit at the back and a concealed zip fastening. Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU) 0 - 28 (US) 4 - 32 (UK) A4 / Letter: 41 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages projector file

products.title: Milena Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: Every season deserves a dress with real wow factor, and this winter it's Milena's turn. And good news, because this dress looks (literally) more complicated than it is to make. The front panels twist around each other, resulting in a unique and flattering twist effect. At the back, elastic at the waist ensures a beautiful, snug fit. Milena fastens at the centre front with buttons, has simple long sleeves and a neckline that is neatly finished with bias tape. Perfect for the festive season or a stylish day at work. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 44 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages projector file

products.title: Inga Jacket Sewing Pattern
products.body: Inga is the epitome of winter simplicity, which is precisely why it is so versatile. This straight jacket fastens with a hook and eye, but feel free to get creative with alternatives: consider a bow ribbon or a toggle closure for a playful look. Inga is fully lined and, thanks to its simple design, you can go wild with your choice of fabric, from cool and casual to chic and festive. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 35 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages projector file

products.title: Greta Jacket Sewing Pattern
products.body: Greta is for those who love special details and a challenge. The seams are sewn inside out and finished with bias tape, creating a unique effect. The welted buttonholes make Greta a challenging sewing project, but you can also opt for regular buttonholes to make it a little easier on yourself. Greta has welted pockets on the front and a neckline finished with an (optional) collar in rib knit. Looking for a nice accessory to go with this jacket? A belt will tie Greta together beautifully. A project that is as versatile as you are. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 45 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages projector file

products.title: Fiora Coat Sewing Pattern
products.body: The coat of the season? Fiora! The ubiquitous coat with integrated scarf is the trend of the moment. Prefer it without the scarf? No problem, you'll get a neat, round neckline. All the details at a glance: fully lined, handy pockets, slit in the centre back, button closure in the centre front, and an extra unique look thanks to the dropped shoulders with wide sleeves. Good to know: you can leave out the waist seams for a minimalist, clean winter look. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 118 pages A0 / US format: 7 pages projector file

products.title: Esme Jacket Sewing Pattern
products.body: With Esme, you enter winter in style. This oversized coat has a collar with a half collar band and an extra, detachable collar that you fasten with hidden loops on the inside. Ideal for playing with different materials such as fur, faux fur or teddy. Esme fastens at the centre front with buttons and has practical patch pockets, a special sleeve insert and an elasticated sleeve hem. Last but not least: Esme is fully lined, so it is beautifully finished both inside and out. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 87 pages A0 / US format: 6 pages projector file

products.title: Avina Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: Avina is the ultimate balance between fitted and flowy. This corset dress fits nicely around the bust and waist, but gives your hips a little more freedom – hello, elegant volume! The neckline and armholes are neatly finished with facing. Wear Avina on its own with heels for a fancy evening look, or as a pinafore dress over a turtleneck or blouse when it gets colder. You decide the length and the vibe. Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU) 0 - 28 (US) 4 - 32 (UK) A4 / Letter: 40 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages projector file

products.title: Pattern Bundle: Autumn Walk
products.body: Enjoy the crisp leaves, the cool breeze, and the warm autumn sun even more in a completely handmade outfit. Our Autumn Walk Pattern Bundle contains 5 patterns that create the perfect look for a cosy stroll. Play with layers, combine fabrics, and create your ideal autumn outfit – warm, comfortable, and totally you. 1. Hylda: A fitted jumper that provides extra warmth on cold days. 2. Allie: Sturdy long trousers that can handle a splash of mud. 3. Griselda: A comfortable jumper that is easy to slip on and off. 4. Irma: A body warmer that keeps your body nice and warm. 5. Anica: An oversized, comfortable coat that keeps you warm when the sun goes in.

products.title: Zizou Top Sewing Pattern
products.body: One pattern, so many possibilities: meet Zizou. A top or dress that always fits perfectly thanks to the bust darts in the front. But the real eye-catcher? That's the scarf detail that you can style however you like. Opt for a wide and a narrow scarf for a loosely draped look, or go for two narrow scarves that you tie together for a chic and festive effect. Prefer to leave the scarf out? Then you'll have an elegant V-neck. Zizou's neckline is finished with a facing, and the sleeves have a slit at the bottom and cuffs for an extra refined finish. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 51 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages projector file

products.title: Kornelia T-shirt Sewing Pattern
products.body: Kornelia is a T-shirt that stands out without being loud. The asymmetrical design gives this classic piece a surprising twist and a fresh, quirky look. The neckline is finished with a neckband that, depending on the stretchiness of your chosen fabric, can be cut from the same fabric or from cuff fabric. A super versatile pattern for a T-shirt that's just that little bit different, yet effortlessly combines with everything in your wardrobe. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 51 pages A0 / US format: 3 page projector file

products.title: Lotta Sweater Sewing Pattern
products.body: Lotta is one of those oversized sweaters that you put on once ... and then never want to take off again. The dropped shoulders and playful balloon hem create volume and a relaxed fit. The gathered sleeves give a casual flair to it, while the ribbed neckband keeps Lotta wonderfully comfy. Perfect for a casual day, a cosy moment at home, or simply as a go-to item that always looks good. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 46 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages projector file

products.title: Vendela Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: Vendela is a long, slightly tailored dress with wide, long sleeves, made for moments that require that little bit extra. The front has an elegant cowl neckline and is cut on the bias, allowing the dress to move smoothly and making it completely dance floor-proof. The back is cut on the straight grain and finished neatly with bias tape at the neckline. No zips, no buttons, no fuss: just slip it on and you're ready to go. The most exciting part is cutting the front on the bias. Once that's done, Vendela can be sewn together surprisingly quickly. Finish the hems with a rolled hem for a refined finish. Hint: due to cutting on the bias, the front and back hems may hang unevenly. Trying it on and determining the correct hemline before finishing it off, will make all the difference. Sizes: XS - X

products.title: Willow Top Sewing Pattern
products.body: Willow is a real eye-catcher. The asymmetrical cut, the deep back neckline and the scarf incorporated into the front neckline create an interesting play of lines and contrasts. On one side a wide shoulder strap and on the other a spaghetti strap with a slider, so you can adjust the fit to your liking. The bust darts ensure a beautiful fit, and the neckline and armholes are neatly finished with facing. Wear Willow as a festive statement top, or extend the pattern and turn it into a dress. Contemporary, daring, and surprisingly versatile: Willow does exactly as she pleases. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 53 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages projector file

products.title: Trina Skirt Sewing Pattern
products.body: Looking for a skirt that stands out without being too loud? It's a match! Trina's clever pleats at the centre front give her an original twist, and the darts at the back ensure a beautiful, snug fit. The concealed zip at the centre back and waist is neatly finished with facing. And yes, there are pockets in the side seam, because we never say no to those. Elegant, slightly different, and surprisingly versatile: Trina is the kind of skirt that effortlessly transitions from weekday wear to dressed-up, time and time again. Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU) 0 - 28 (US) 4 - 32 (UK) A4 / Letter: 33 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages projector file

products.title: Sanna Top Sewing Pattern
products.body: Sanna is one of those tops that seems simple at first glance, but reveals its secrets at second glance. The long, attached sleeves feature pleated details at the cuffs, creating a beautiful shape and a soft, stylish flow. Sanna keeps it clean with a round neckline at the front, while the back features original peepholes for that subtle wow factor. The neck and centre back are neatly finished with facing, so that the inside also looks perfect. Sanna is proof that you don't need frills to stand out: clean, quirky, and ideal for those who love subtle details. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 35 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages projector file

products.title: Ronya Blouse Sewing Pattern
products.body: Ronya is a loose, minimalist wrap blouse that perfectly captures the pyjama chic trend. Pair it with comfy pants like Perry, Kenza, or Freja for a relaxed yet super stylish look. Ronya's straight, long sleeves with cuffs and the neatly finished neckline and centre front with facing create a sleek and polished look. And then you have the ties: you set the mood. Wrapped, tight, loose, or playfully knotted? Ronya effortlessly adapts to you. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 44 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages projector file

products.title: Jacoba Blazer Sewing Pattern
products.body: Jacoba is an open-neck blazer that exudes effortless class, with a wide neckline, a welt pocket, and a concealed button closure. The side seams are slightly tailored, which creates a feminine silhouette without feeling tight. The grown-on (balloon) sleeves are curved at the shoulders and taper towards the sleeve hem, creating a flattering effect that perfectly complements the tailored fit. Jacoba is fully lined and therefore just as beautiful on the inside as on the outside. A blazer that works just as well at the office as it does at an after-work dinner. Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU) 0 - 28 (US) 4 - 32 (UK) A4 / Letter: 61 pages A0 / US format: 5 pages projector file

products.title: Caren Blouse Sewing Pattern
products.body: Caren plays it smart: soft and romantic, but with a sleek counterpart. Romantic, thanks to the gathers all around. Sleek, thanks to the pointed collar with collar band and the yoke in the front and back that ensures a nice fit around the shoulders. The concealed button closure at the center front gives Caren a clean look, and then there's that little slit in the sleeve that adds a bit more oomph. Perfect for days when you want to be elegant without being too classic. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 42 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages projector file

products.title: Barbro Trousers Sewing Pattern
products.body: Barbro is Gizeh's big sister: a pair of barrel leg jeans with just that little bit of extra sparkle. The darts at the knee and hem give the legs their distinctive curved shape, while the trendy asymmetrical fly adds a fun detail. With a straight waistband, belt loops, and all the classic jeans elements such as side pockets (including a coin pocket), patch back pockets, a yoke in the back and double topstitching ... these jeans really have it all. Finally, the rounded hem with facing ensures a neat and tidy finish. Barbro is a pair of jeans that is just as great for a casual look as it is for a statement outfit Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU) 0 - 28 (US) 4 - 32 (UK) A4 / Letter: 61 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages projector file

products.title: Astrid Jacket Sewing Pattern
products.body: Oversized, bold, yet feminine: Astrid ticks all the boxes. The playful balloon hem and dropped shoulders give this jacket a powerful, contemporary silhouette, while the topstitching clearly has the wow factor. The zip is neatly concealed under the zip placket, and the zip pockets are both practical and stylish. Astrid is fully lined and scores extra points with an elegant sleeve slit, a cuff at the sleeve hem, and a collar with a half collar band that fits beautifully. A jacket that effortlessly transitions between casual cool and city chic. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 58 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages projector file

products.title: Ola Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: Ola is a loose dress with an asymmetrical button closure at the front that flatters the waist. The ties on the inside keep everything neatly in place (no unexpected glimpses, we promise!), and the gathers at the neckline in the back give Ola a subtle playful accent. The sleeves also get that little bit extra: pleats in the sleeve hem, finished with a cuff and sleeve slit. The stand-up collar adds the finishing touch and makes Ola a real must-sew. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 54 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages projector file

products.title: Bowie Bag Sewing Pattern (Fibre Mood x Jessica)
products.body: Bowie is a versatile bag that can be worn in two ways thanks to the tie with press stud. Transform it into a playful bow bag, or leave the tie off and you have a spacious, practical bag in which you can quickly store all your essentials. Handy for daytime use, festive accessory for the evening! * For the sizing guide and information about the materials, please download the instructions.

products.title: Lina Top Knitting Pattern
products.body: Lina is the life of the party this summer! Featuring fun and flirty fringed sleeves and a round neckline with a feature stitch at the back. You have the option to knit Lina in straight stitch or purl stocking stitch. Sizes: XS - XXL A4/Letter: 6 pages

products.title: Rio Jumper Knitting Pattern
products.body: Once you start working on the Rio Jumper, you won’t be able to put it down. Knit the jumper in rice stitch and the jacquard pattern in stockinette. There are two patterns to choose from. Sizes: 4y - 14y A4 / Letter: 2x 8 pages

products.title: Pia Cardigan Knitting Pattern
products.body: Those last rays of sun aren’t quite warm enough, so it's time to pull on a light knitted garment over your outfit. Pia looks stylish and is the perfect project for your autumn wardrobe. The cardigan is knit from one piece and has a double row of buttons down the front, creating a subtle wrap effect. Bring on those final summer evenings! Sizes: XS - XXL A4 / Letter: 5 pages

products.title: Milla Scarf Knitting Pattern
products.body: Scarf and cape in one, Milla is your go-to winter warmer! An easy project to complete your wardrobe, it's knit entirely in elastic rib stitch. Thanks to the handy armholes, Milla transforms from scarf to cape. Sizes: One A4/Letter: 4 pages

products.title: Sammy Cardigan Knitting Pattern
products.body: Sammy has the ultimate cuddle-factor! You can knit this easy baby cardigan with pockets in just one go, using a net stitch. Sizes: 1-3m / 6-9m / 12-18m A4/Letter: 5 pages

products.title: Monica Mini Pullover Knitting Pattern
products.body: Meet Monica Mini, the daughter of Monica Maxi. She's just as charming as her adult version and fits like a dream. It's all in the balloon sleeves for Monica Mini; the only thing left to do is decide on a flashy bright or trending pastel. Either way you're guaranteed to have a happy camper when you're done! Sizes: 4y - 14y A4 / Letter: 6 pages

products.title: Monica Maxi Pullover Knitting Pattern
products.body: Women’s pullover with puffed sleeves in stockinette stitch. Sizes: XS - XXL A4 / Letter: 6 pages

products.title: Pixie Jumper Knitting Pattern
products.body: Pixie is synonymous for practical, both where making and wearing are concerned. You'll start out with a simple stockinette stitch and end up with a wonderful jumper favourite for your (grand)daughter, niece or godchild. With short, wide sleeves, a ribbed hem and boat neck, the Pixie is pure simplicity & the happiness comes free! Sizes: 4 y - 14 y A4 / Letter: 5 pages

products.title: Jamie Pullover Knitting Pattern
products.body: This cosy pullover in garter stitch is a definite must-have for your little and not-so-little ones. Jamie is nice, roomy and super comfy! The design is simple, with a collar long sleeves and a ribbed hem. Knit it in one colour – soft & muted or fun & flashy and easy, or in colour blocks (for a little more of a challenge). Sizes: 1-3 m / 6-9 m / 12-18 m 2 y - 14 y A4 / Letter: 5 pages

products.title: Fleur Jacket Knitting Pattern
products.body: Give your child’s outfit a colourful touch with this Fleur sleeveless jacket. The knitted ruffles look like little wings and have a high cuddly quotient. Your child is guaranteed to breeze through the day. Sizes: 2y -14y A4/Letter: 4 pages

products.title: Oda Top Knitting Pattern
products.body: This round neck oversized top with short sleeves is the perfect solution for mid-season. Oda Top: We made the Oda in a silk and mohair blend so that the top would have a fluid drape. Oda Stripes: It’s the same as the Oda pattern, but this version has stripes at the top of the front. Sizes: one size Oda Top A4/Letter: 5 pages Oda Stripes A4/Letter: 5 pages

products.title: Tia and Lily Bag Knitting Pattern
products.body: DIY TIA Tia is a handy fabric tote bag with macramé details. If you're more of a ‘less-is-more’ type, just omit the macramé detail. DIY LILY This sweet macramé clutch instantly gives you that summer holiday feeling. This handbag isn't just pretty – the strap makes it practical too! A4 / Letter: 11 pages A0 / US format: 1 page

products.title: Yvonne Jumper Knitting Pattern
products.body: A loose V-neck jumper with raglan puff sleeves in rib stitch. The V-neckline can be worn both at the front or the back. Sizes: XS - L A4/Letter: 6 pages

products.title: Moussa Jumper Knitting Pattern
products.body: This cotton wool jumper is perfect for spring. You can knit the model with plenty of horizontal lines or you can go for the pattern with more playful lines. Sizes: 2y - 14y A4/Letter: 6 pages

products.title: Primrose Sweater Knitting Pattern
products.body: The Primrose sweater is an easy to knit girl’s sweater with 3/4 length puffed sleeves that uses a garter stitch. Sizes: 2y - 14y A4: 5 pages

products.title: Lila Sweater Knitting Pattern
products.body: Right at the top of the winter wish list: the loose-fitting Lila sweater for women in reverse purl stitch. The sweater's bishop sleeves and wide collar give it a trendy look. You can choose to knit 1 or 2 waves on the front. Sizes XS - XL A4/Letter: 5 pages

products.title: Helena Top Knitting Pattern
products.body: This light, boxy crochet top in cotton will be your new favourite wardrobe staple. Helena is a beginner level project that requires some counting and concentration... But the results speak for themselves! Sizes: XS - XXL A4 / Letter: 5 pages A0 / US format: 1 page

products.title: Bliss Scarf Knitting Pattern
products.body: Your little person can set off for schoolsnug as a bug in a rug this winter with the Bliss scarf. An easy beginner project that's as fun as it is fast, all you have to do is knit long horizontal bands in a simple rib stitch. Have fun with colour combos and play with the width of the bands! Sizes: 2-14 A4/Letter: 4 pages

products.title: Tara Jumper Ribbed Knitting Pattern
products.body: Short, oversized jumper with 7/8 sleeves in soft wool. The jumper is easy to knit in stocking stitch with a strip in garter stitch. It’s not hard to get started knitting your own jumper with the Tara pattern and the knitting instructions that come with it. Pleasure guaranteed. Sizes: XS-M A4/Letter: 5 pages

products.title: Tara Jumper with Stripes Knitting Pattern
products.body: Oversized jumper with ¾-length sleeves for mother and daughter. High hugging factor guaranteed. In off-white with continual horizontal colored stripes. The jumper is easy to knit in stocking stitch. Pleasure guaranteed. Sizes: XS-L A4/Letter: 5 pages

products.title: Janus Sweater Knitting Pattern
products.body: Sweet sweater with rounded neckline and raglan sleeves. Especially for kids who love animals and wild hair. Sizes: 2y - 14y A4/Letter: 5 pages

products.title: Tara Mini Jumper Knitting Pattern
products.body: A lovely and soft oversized jumper for your (grand) daughter, niece or younger sister. This jumper is easy to knit in stocking stitch, just pay attention to the horizontal strips of colour. Guaranteed knitting fun. Sizes: 2y - 14y A4/Letter: 5 pages

Our patterns blend glamour with chic, the perfect combination for the warm summer evenings and events ahead! So, without further ado – meet our patterns! Lia is a unique boho-chic top that shows your shoulders off. Grand for summer’s heatwaves! Eager to hop onto the ‘Bermuda’ trend? The Rachel pattern is perfect! You’ll have these on-trend Bermuda shorts done in no time! Simone combines elegance and glamour with ruffled tiers on the front and ruffled sleeves. Plus, you can sew this pattern as a dress or a top – um... yes, please! And don’t forget to check out our other patterns: Jill , Kate , Meryll , Milly , Nina , Tanita , Veronica , Viva , and Zita . This issue tops up your wardrobe with adventurous items made to be worn out in the wonderful, wide world. We can finally head back out after all that ‘hibernation’ – and we're ready to celebrate! We're incredibly excited to introduce just a few of our latest patterns. Head out comfortably and in style in your new Elora dress. This graceful A-line dress is bound to snare you with its charm. Not a big fan of dresses? Relax! Elora can also be made as a romantic blouse. Still haven't found that perfect spring jacket? Great news! Madou is just what you’re looking for. products.body: Hey there, it’s that time again! We're back with bunches of fab summer sewing patterns and genuine must-haves! At first glance, Alena looks like a simple, casual dress with a round neckline and short sleeves. Spin her 'round though and you'll discover an elegantly designed back opening. Breeze into the warm temperatures of summer in Chloe . Be prepared for all the admiration when you wear this flowing, asymmetrical, off-the-shoulder top. Easy, breezy, comfy chic – that's the A-line Dolly dress. Elegance in no time at all? The Ezra pencil skirt does the trick. Try pairing it with the Viola top in the same fabric for a winning outfit. Onah's motto? Let's do the twist! These trousers enjoy the quirky life with a waistband, trendy asymmetrical fastening, interesting pleats (one runs all the wa

products.body: Hey there, it’s that time again! We're back with bunches of spring sewing patterns and genuine must-haves! Aila , a slightly oversized blouse with a collar and collar band, yoke and gathers at the back. Grace , a blouse with a charming cut that features a standing collar with a bow at the back and raglan balloon sleeves with a fitted cuff. Inspired by sailor shirts, Harmony is a treat for anyone who can’t get enough retro vibes. Maya is a super feminine A-line dress with a round neckline that hugs your body. Also meet Bloom , Danna , Fiona , Joy , Noelle , Rosa , Rupert and Vera in this spring issue of Fibre Mood. This Pattern Book is a magazine and is therefore excluded from the right of withdrawal. This does not apply to magazine subscriptions.

This colourful edition provides you with the ideal looks for all your summer plans. Whether you go to the beach, take a city break or just enjoy a staycation, this edition will make you shine like the sun! Discover the patterns: Kamala , Leanne , Maeve , Nona , Oriana , Petula , Quilla , Ruba , Selah , Trix , Uzma and Vivienne . products.body: A soft edition with a bold character: that's Fibre Mood 31. Indulge in a cosy Dila coat , a cute Anica jacket , or go for a lovely Griselda jumper – those statement collars are ready to protect you from inclement weather. Even more softness? Off-white, light beige, and vanilla make this edition, literally, they are the crème de la crème. With the festive season upon us, let’s add some glitter and sparkle! Electra puts you, along with its eye-catching bow, in the spotlight while the versatile Onyx dress accompanies you on the dance floor. You can also create a festive, classy, and trendy set with the Zerah gilet and Lux trousers . Prepare yourself for some serious decision paralysis and rock the winter in style and warmth with the patterns from edition 31! Curious? Get started with Anica ,

products.title: Pattern Book 30
products.body: Explore the unique mix of nature-inspired colors and fabrics in Fibre Mood 30 and dream away to a trendy autumn with cozy, earthy vibes full of warm, dark tones and powerful contrasts that this must-have edition has in store for you. The collection features 12 must-have patterns for both fashion-conscious trendsetters and sewistas looking for comfort. From basic T-shirts and versatile layering pieces to trending pleated skirts and eye-catching blouses - the pieces in edition 30 are all about mixing and matching and aimed at sewistas of every level. Curious? Get started with Abina , Bliss , Carline , Deliz , Elsie , Fausta , Gizeh , Havana , Ildri , Jessa , Kimya and Leiko and take your wardrobe to the next level. This Pattern Book is a magazine and is therefore excluded from the right of w

products.body: Fibre Mood 29 is a reflection of creative freedom: this means an edition where anything goes! With its 12 sunny patterns, this issue is the sum of vibrant colours, bold fabrics and contemporary summer trends. In short, all the ingredients to take your summer wardrobe to the next level and bring your unique style to life. Embrace romantic boho vibes with the Gedda skirt , discover Khloe's trending apron-neckline and combine comfort and fun with the Bruna skort . Sew one of the top versions of our dresses for a sophisticated outfit. So get ready to travel to a place where your imagination knows no bounds and enjoy the colourful versatility of a blissful summer wardrobe! ☀️ Can't wait? Then let’s meet Alberthe , Bruna , Christine , Dasha , Elvira , Felicia , Gedda , Hallie , Ines , June , Khl

From edgy statement pieces and festive eye-catchers yearning for a dance to more everyday fits and the perfect spring bomber. This unique issue has it all and is sure to leave you with plenty of compliments, because that wow factor is hidden in every pattern. Prepare for a sunny season with asymmetrical beauties Ashley , Florrie and Hailey and blow everyone away with Dallas , an ultra-festive dress with surprising back detail hidden under a dashing cape. Or could your wardrobe still use some tops? Becca , Lilian and Georgie are only too happy to let you get your hands on them. This sewing magazine is eager to introduce itself to you, so don't wait any longer and meet your new spring favourites! Can't wait? Then
