Because with this XL edition, we have for you no less than 15 essential sewing patterns with lots of different variations. Think of Joni our timeless blazer, wear-with-everything bodysuit Cheryl , comfy t-shirt Erica , and button-down shirt Odyna . In short: a whole host of indispensable must-haves with which you can effortlessly complement your me-made (capsule) wardrobe with sophisticated pieces that are easy to mix and match. ✨ No garments will be left hanging lonely in your closet because with Fibre Mood 27/Special n°3, they will no doubt find a partner in crime. Can't wait? Then let’s meet Cheryl , Delma , Donna , Elza , Erica , Gina , Hylda , Joni , Jorla , Kenza , Lara , Mo

The issue 26 from Fibre Mood is bound to make you change your mind! ❄️ Warm up with 12 sewing patterns, with handy tutorials and variations to create different versions of your favourite patterns. Were you still looking for a cosy cardigan, elegant jumpsuit, classy skirt or are you secretly already looking ahead to the holidays and can't wait to create that perfect party dress? Then this edition is perfect for you! So get going with edition 26, because what could be more fun than adding to your own wardrobe on a cold winter day? ✨ Addie , Cloud , Nova , Pax and the other patterns from this edition are already eager to introduce themselves to you! ✨ This Pattern Book is a magazine and is therefore excluded from the right of withdrawal. products.body: We are slowly saying goodbye to summer, but are secretly already looking forward to cosy autumn scenes and matching cosy outfits! With edition 25, we welcome another 12 patterns, suitable for a sunny Indian summer and an autumnal touch. With Dunya , a trendy short jacket, you'll defy that fall in style! Also jacket Vinny will help you during the mid-season. With Marah , you have a versatile skirt, do you go for short during a blissful late summer or opt for long? Up to you! Do you prefer a timeless dress? Then you will undoubtedly fall in love with Yushu , classy and comfy at the same time. products.body: Get ready for endless sewing fun with our Special! ✂️ With no less than 19(!) summer patterns, this edition contains something for everyone, whether it is things for the summer holidays, accessories or childrenswear. We would like to introduce you to our patterns - including this time a swimsuit / bodysuit and a baseball cap if you're up for a challenge! A day at the beach, a trip, cozy barbecues, parties...you'll always have an outfit for every occasion. Adapt the patterns to your liking, finish your summer outfit with accessories like the oversized Mehri bag . For womenswear, we have for you Augusta , Blossom , Coral , Dahlia , Dune , Lucca , Nikka , Ocean . And the kids can spend their days with Daisy , Kira , Marisol , Parker , Pearl , Rae and Sunny . Or are you in the mood for a quick

products.title: Pattern Book Special n°4
products.body: Ready, set… or just relax! Special no. 4 is all about sporty essentials and comfy everyday pieces. Each design moves with you, whether you are off to a yoga session, lounging on the sofa, heading out for a hike or enjoying a weekend away. Comfort meets style in every pattern, with clever details that give your outfit that little something extra. Whether you are after a matching workout set or some cosy loungewear, this Special has something for marathon runners, yoga lovers, hikers – and homebodies – alike. Fibre Mood Special no. 4 is packed full of patterns that are perfect for an active yet relaxed lifestyle. Think Yuki, the yoga leggings; Dymar, the sports top; and Ash, the retro training jacket, alongside cosy sweaters like Boreal and Dyron. And let’s not forget Arya, the ultimate comf

products.title: Pattern Book 34
products.body: The holidays begin with Fibre Mood 34. It is the perfect moment to slow down, step away from your busy schedule, and make space for creativity. Whether you are staying home or heading off on a trip, this edition invites you to take it easy and create something beautiful with your own hands. It is also a good time to ground yourself. Consider natural fabrics and earthy tones like sand, olive green, white, and bold, fiery reds – colours that bring warmth and character to any outfit, ready for a summer of freedom. Fibre Mood 34 brings you the perfect pieces for city trips and sunny days close to home: the flowing Azure dress, the ultra-summery Nanaka top, which feels like a cloud against your skin, the Liberty playsuit, and the Marley shirtdress. And what about Muriel? It truly stands out wit

products.title: Pattern Book 32
products.body: Spring breathes freshness, lightness and playfulness, and you can feel it in every pattern in Fibre Mood 32. From the boxy Judith bomber and cropped Carly jacket to the comfy wide-leg Allie and Lucia trousers and oversized Hamsa and Kristy blouses. And how about India, the oh-so-timeless spring dress? Not to mention the ultimate spring coat and the trend of the moment: the Bermuda shorts. These and so many more sewing patterns are ready to enrich your wardrobe. Get inspired by fresh, lightweight fabrics and this season's trending denim looks. Are you going for a romantic, cool, or laid-back vibe this spring? With Issue 32, you have everything you need to step into spring with style and ease. Curious? Get started with Allie , Bree , Carly , Devika , Esha , Fulki , Gitika , Hamsa , India , J

products.title: Tallulah Top Sewing Pattern
products.body: Tallulah takes Cleo’s round neck and lantern sleeves and combines them with Tanita’s elastic hem band. The back features an eye-catching gathered porthole cut-out. Buttons on the back of the hem band allow you to tighten the waist for a beautiful billowy Tallulah top. You could leave the hem bands unbuttoned, but in that case, we recommend making them a touch longer. Practical, timeless, and easy to mix and match. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 34 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages

products.title: Tammy Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: Tammy is love at first sight and reminds us of the Edith blouse, Paulette blouse, and Rosie dress. This dress (or pinafore, if you like!) needs little introduction with its sleek A-line cut and V-shaped ruffled bodice detail. The ruffle draws attention to the waist, and the ties in the side panels give the option for extra waist definition. You’ve got options galore – make Tammy a pinafore or a dress with tied 3/4-length sleeves. What do you think...mini, midi, or maxi? Tammy’s neckline has a clean bias tape finish. A concealed zip down the back adds the final touch. This dress is well worth the time investment. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 57 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages

products.title: Mindy Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: There's statement sleeves and there's the statement sleeves. Mindy definitely falls in the latter category. This Balkan inspired dress with a gorgeous square neckline (another super trend!) is destined to be a hit! Love the big sleeves, but not wild about the puffy effect? Leave out the elastic in the sleeve hem and you've got yourself a pair of fluttery butterfly sleeves. Mindy is neatly fitted at the bust, with an A-line skirt that slightly flares. Sizes: 32 - 58 (EU) 0 - 26 (US) 4 - 30 (UK) A4 / Letter: 25 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages

products.title: Jutta Skirt Sewing Pattern
products.body: Jutta is an A-line skirt with very comfortable slit pockets. The chord used to close the skirt gives your waist a striking touch. It falls to just below the knee and has the option to be worn fitted on the waist or loose around the hips. Jutta will take you from beach to bar, all season long! Bekijk de Sew Along hier . Sizes: 32 - 58 (EU) 0 - 26 (US) 4 - 30 (UK) A4 / Letter: 27 pages A0 / US format: 1 page

products.title: Bruno Hat Sewing Pattern
products.body: Glow up your outfit with a super-trendy accessory, the Bruno bucket hat! It’s easy-peasy to make and done in no time. Why not sew two – one for the summer and one in a warm fabric for the winter? Size: XS - L A4 / Letter: 7 pages

products.title: James T-shirt Sewing Pattern
products.body: James is a unisex boat neck T-shirt and a must have for every wardrobe. The sleeves can be worn rolled up into cuffs. Get creative with the grainline on the chest pocket or use a contrasting fabric to add your own twist on the James. For a ladies version of this pattern, check out the Afra T-shirt here and for a kids version of this pattern, check out the Cory T-shirt here . Sizes: XS - XL A4 / Letter: 23 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages

products.title: Josie Boxy Top Sewing Pattern
products.body: The Josie boxy top is an offshoot /pattern hack of the Josie top. As the name suggests, this top is a shorter, looser version of the basic model. Pair it with a skirt or a pair of high-waisted trousers. Sizes: 32 - 48 (EU) 0 - 16 (US) 4 - 20 (UK) A4: 17 pages A0: 1 page

products.title: Lucille Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: This dress accentuates your waist with ties that can be tied at the front or back. Knot it to show off just a shade of midriff. Other features include the dolman sleeves finished with elastic and a flared panel skirt for an elegant, beautiful drape. Oh, before we forget! There’s also a concealed zip down the back. In short, Lucille is elegant, beautiful, and festive. And– that’s a wrap! Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU), 4 - 32 (UK), 0 - 28 (US) A4 / Letter: 53 pages A0 / US format: 4 pages

products.title: Reese Jacket Sewing Pattern
products.body: Meet the match to (adult) Adria jacket . This unlined boxy oversized jacket for kids has an eye for detail with topstitching for a splash of cool and gusseted patch pockets for volume. Reese is the perfect reason to start thinking about autumn now. Sizes: 2 - 14 years A4/Letter: 27 pages A0/US Format: 2 pages

products.title: Marcia Jacket Sewing Pattern
products.body: If you loved the Micky bodywarmer and Frida jacket, then Marcia will be right up your street. It’s a versatile pattern that can serve as a bodywarmer, a first-rate (winter) coat, or a lightweight jacket to complete your outfit. Best feature? Sleeves that zip on and off depending on your mood! Marcia looks amazing, with or without the standing collar. Fancy some extra details? Then add slash pockets for extra flair. But if you want to keep it simple, just skip them. The sleeves and hem band are finished with elastic. Twinning is winning – sew a Mickey for the child in your life and wear Marcia yourself for a mega match! Practical, timeless, and versatile. Sizes: XS-XXXL A4 / Letter: 38 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages

products.title: Nellie Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: There’s no need for bells and whistles with this simple (mini) dress. Both sleeves and dress flare towards the hem. The round neckline is finished with bias tape. A button and loop secure the deep back. Sometimes, straightforward is best. Loose, no-nonsense, and easy to wear – who wouldn’t want that? Check out the sew along of this pattern here ! Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 38 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages

products.title: Octavia Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: The Charlotte wrap dress was the muse for our Octavia dress. But muse doesn’t mean the same. We altered the pleats in the sleeve cap to give a more voluminous feel at the top. Octavia’s sleeves are also tapered towards the wrist. The gathers in the bodice emphasise the waist, which unfurls into a generous, flared skirt. And since we wanted to keep it a simpler project, Octavia’s finish is zip and buttonhole-free! The dress closes with snap fasteners, with or without a tie at the waist. Oh-so-comfy, super on-trend, and chic to a tee. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 57 pages A0 / US format: 4 pages

products.title: Rhonda Top Sewing Pattern
products.body: Mix our Josie and Harmony patterns for a match made in heaven – Rhonda. And this time, there’s even more flair. This clean, streamlined top has long panels at the front and back with somewhat shorter side panels. Other eye-catching details include the round neckline, button back, and wide set in sleeves. Rhonda will always be a hit, whatever the occasion. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 30 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages

products.title: Ruby Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: Blend the Maude dress with the Paola jumper and you get the outlines of Ruby. A loose jumper, just longer, i.e. a jumper dress. From calf to knee-length or even mini – anything goes. These details are what make the dress special: dropped shoulders, sleeves with just enough gathers, convenient slits in the side seams, and (optional) ribbed cuffs. Ruby strikes the perfect sporty-chic balance. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 38 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages

products.title: Sasha Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: The romantic wins the day with this festive, billowy dress. Sasha’s criss cross ties add interest to the back (and it’s bra friendly!). Make this dress with or without an elastic waist. And the length? That’s also up to you! Ditch the ruffled tiers, and you’ve got a gorgeous top. Add two tiers or more to increase the length of your dress. The gathers at the top and the deep pleats at the sleeve trim turn up the flair. Sleeve trim gives the slightly puffed sleeves the perfect drape. Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU) 0 - 28 (US) 4 - 32 (UK) A4: 41 pages A0: 2 pages

products.title: Kate Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: Wearing Kate does your figure nothing but favours. The seams down the bodice front and back create a clean, tailored fit at the bust and midriff. Kate’s skirt flares elegantly towards the hem. The gathers at the shoulders of the butterfly sleeves add a whimsical touch. Now, add a row of buttons down the front – tone on tone or in a contrasting colour – and you've got a date with Kate! The location of the bottom button determines how much leg you show. Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU) 0 - 28 (US) 4 - 32 (UK) A4 / Letter: 48 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages

products.title: Josephine Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: No offence to Ms Baker, but this Josephine is no banana skirt. Instead, it’s an ultra-feminine dress with a jewel neck, and a V-shaped keyhole finished with bias tape. The back fastens with a button. Josephine’s elegant bishop sleeves taper at the end with narrow barrel cuffs. And this dress is a hacker ’s dream. Just imagine the options... a dress with a gathered top, waist seam, and a long, flared skirt, optionally tightened at the waist with a belt. Or you could go with a classic blouse, or even lengthen it into a relaxed tunic, again – with or without a belt. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 38 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages

products.title: Kika Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: This empire waist dress is the epitome of comfort. The skirt features scooped pockets, gathers, and an elegant A-line. The V-neck makes your neck look longer. The shaped sleeves provide visual allure with gathers at the top and tapered elastic wrist cuff that you can turn up for a lovely puff effect. Kika looks a treat in many different fabrics and lengths. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 56 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages

products.title: Jill Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: Enter the bliss of sunshiny sleeveless summers. Jill has got an elegant, round neckline and a strategically placed bra friendly cut-out at the back. The back fastens at the top with a rouleau loop and button. And it's up to you to decide how much waist definition you want - we have both elastic and ties! Which way was that garden party again? Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 31 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages

products.title: Vanya Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: There’s nothing everyday about Vanya's design. Awaken the goddess within with this Vanya’s fitted bodice and A-line skirt. The gorgeous statement sleeves are elbow-length and gather romantically at the shoulders to create a stunning trapeze neckline too. The princess seams follow your curves and we’ve also added a front slit for the extra wow factor Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU) 0 - 28 (US) 4 - 32 (UK) A4 / Letter: 73 pages A0 / US format: 4 pages

products.title: Wanda Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: Wearing the Wanda mini dress is such a treat. It's super laid-back, with an ideal length and three-quarter draped sleeves. Plus there’s a lace-up décolleté – leather or not – with metal eyelets to make it lady-of-the-castle worthy. All kinds of fabrics work well with this great pattern. Did we mention there’s also side seam pockets? Don’t be alarmed if a love-struck troubadour shows up unannounced beneath your bedroom window! Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU) 0 - 28 (US) 4 - 32 (UK) A4 / Letter: 35 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages

products.title: Jules Jumper Sewing Pattern
products.body: Jules, the sleeveless jumper is cute as a button. And it's doubly adorable when twinning with mum Thea. It’s got a wonderful deep V-neck, with ribbed trim binding (ditto the hem band!) and a relaxed fit. The separate side seam panels that extend from hem to shoulder add extra character. And that's all she wrote, folks. Jules is simply Jules. Sizes: 2-14 years A4 / Letter: 15 pages A0 / US format: 1 page

products.title: Amelia Jumpsuit Sewing Pattern
products.body: Meet the all-in-one fashion item. Amelia is a gorgeous addition to your wardrobe. This relaxed jumpsuit pattern will keep you busy for a while. Like our Aila blouse, Amelia has short, grown on sleeves. Take your moment to observe all the other details: cropped trouser leg, a standing collar, concealed zip, a topstitched belt, and a yoke. Last but not least, Amelia has handy side seam pockets. Take a deep breath, and...you’re off! Wear this gorgeous make for confidence in spades. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 50 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages

products.title: Elba Waistcoat Sewing Pattern
products.body: Remember our classic Hunter coat pattern? That was our muse for this all-season waistcoat. Sometimes it’s good to turn up the charm. which is why we gave Elba so many eye-catching details on the front. It’s double-breasted and has an elegant collar with lapels. shoulder pads. a slash chest pocket. and side pockets. Fully lined. Elba feels extra luxurious. And the slit at the back ensures plenty of freedom of movement. Pair Elba with the Freja trousers or Peaches trousers for a guaranteed show-stopper. This waistcoat is bound to be an all-seasons classic – timeless with a subtle unisex feel. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4: 73 pages A0: 5 pages

products.title: Freja Trousers Sewing Pattern
products.body: Uncomplicated. Casual. Timeless. Toss the Benita and Peaches trousers in a creative shaker, and you get the Freja. Freja has wide legs, elegant pleats at the front, and convenient slash pockets. And this time around, we went a simpler route with a faux fly. You can just pull up your trousers and go with the elastic waistband. And the length? You can alter it in a flash. Go for it Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU) 0 - 28 (US) 4 - 32 (UK) A4 / Letter: 41 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages

products.title: Harlem Cape Sewing Pattern
products.body: Ponchos are back in style! This versatile fashion cape is your solution to autumn’s mercurial weather. Bonus features include the kangaroo pocket and practical snap fasteners on the front and sides. And we kept our cyclists in mind with a back that’s slightly longer than the front. Stay fashionably warm and dry. Size: XS - XL A4/ Letter: 47 pages A0/ US Format: 3 pages

products.title: Irene Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: Irene is simply spectacular. A gorgeous straight dress with a standing collar and asymmetrical buttons down the front. Feel free to play with the length, from short and shorter to just a touch longer. Midi will give you your golden average. Worn with a belt, you can accentuate your waist and add a graceful billow at the top. Irene looks stunning in all kinds of fabrics. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 59 pages A0 / US format: 4 pages

products.title: Odille Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: Sometimes girls want to look a little more grown-up. This oversized dress with dropped short sleeves has a stylish collar and handy button closure. The details complete the picture with a yoke, gathers at the front and back, and oh-so-handy hidden side seam pockets. Select the length based on what works for you. We made our Odille (just below) knee-length. Sizes: 2 - 14 y A4 / Letter: 27 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages

products.title: Elora Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: Elora is a bit nostalgic but still totally today – especially in a daring print or bold stripe. Unicolour is also great, especially in a trendy earth tone, sky blue, or vanilla. This graceful A-line dress is bound to capture you with its charm – with or without a belt. Elora has a U-neck, balloon raglan sleeves, ruffles and gathers, and a generous topstitched hem. And lucky for you – no buttons or zips! Would you prefer a romantic top? Go for it! Sizes: XS-XXXL A4 / Letter: 50 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages

products.title: Lia Top Sewing Pattern
products.body: What says summer better than bare shoulders? Well, Lia has got those bases (un!)covered. This unique off-the-shoulder top is tastefully tailored above the bust and gracefully fans out underneath. The knife pleats add fullness to the top, and the statement sleeves have a curved hemline. That curve leads to a sleeve that's shorter at the front than at the underarm seam. Bring on the sunshine! Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 38 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages

products.title: Gabby Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: Meet Gabby, with the ‘G’ from ‘good time’ and ‘graceful’. And it does it all without extravagant details, just the alluring play of lines and bust darts. This dress has a wonderful willowy drape. The triangular insert (godet) at the front is an eye-catcher although the two-in-one balloon sleeves - with a shorter inner sleeve that pulls the outer sleeve in – do give them a run for their money. Gabby’s got some drama going on, but is still wonderfully simple somehow. Some people have just got *it*. No more drama? Drop the godet – simple as that. Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU) | 0 - 28 (US) | 4 - 32 (UK) A4 / Letter: 59 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages

products.title: Harriette Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: Introducing Harriette, aka Calamity Jane. Done up in denim, and it’s horseback and hazard-ready. But in a sturdy beige or olive-green fabric, we’d say more ‘Mrs Livingstone, I presume?’. Even still, this bold and versatile dress looks divine in a subtle floral print. The skirt joins the bodice with a lovely, gathered seam. Add a no-nonsense collar, patch chest pockets with flap, sleeves with a slit, and a button placket – all you need is a sturdy belt, and you're all set. Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU) 0 - 28 (US) 4 - 32 (UK) A4 / Letter: 70 pages A0 / US format: 4 pages

products.title: Jemma Skirt Sewing Pattern
products.body: The billowy Jemma skirt is dazzling in its simplicity. A sea of fabric gathers streams from the delicate waistband. With the wind in your sails, you’re free! Those are all the frills there are; the rest is smooth sailing. Jemma has practical snap fasteners and side seam pockets. We made ours ankle-length, but you do you! Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU) 0 - 28 (US) 4 - 32 (UK) A4 / Letter: 27 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages

products.title: Madou Overshirt Sewing Pattern
products.body: Line dancing, anyone? Or stories by the campfire? Country vibes, lumberjack, trucker – it makes no difference. Madou is always you. This overshirt is for making and wearing without much ado. Denim, checked flannel, plain, sturdy linen – it’s all good. Just take your pick. The same goes for the length. The long, narrow chest pockets are shoo-in crowd-pleasers and the two rows of topstitching throughout are a must. Sizes: XS-XXXL A4 / Letter: 38 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages

products.title: Sienna Top Sewing Pattern
products.body: Seriously, what a darling! With its roomy yet elegant cut, deep pleat, and fabulous gathers – Sienna has got it all. And don't forget the gently curved neckline, discreetly concealed buttons, and short sleeves with buttoned cuffs. Sienna was made to go with anything, whether with jeans, culottes, dress trousers, or a long straight skirt. Style upgrade guaranteed. Sizes: XS-XXXL A4 / Letter: 27 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages

products.title: Thea Jumper Sewing Pattern
products.body: Shoulder pads give this sleeveless Thea jumper a super fun twist. This basic isn’t tied to the seasons and is a snap to make. We added ribbed trim to the deep V-neck binding and hem band. You could also just use your main fabric, as long as it's stretchy enough. Want to twin with your child? Thea and Jules are a treat together. Check out the sew along of this pattern here ! Sizes: XS-XXXL

products.title: Jo Pullover Sewing Pattern
products.body: Marie Kondo’s rule of thumb is that simplicity is beauty. This short Pullover with three-quarter-length balloon sleeves is sure to become one of your favourite wardrobe basics. Trim fabric is used for the neck binding, wrist trim, and hem band. Jo can be vogue or sporty with trousers or chic with a skirt. This sewing project is definitely beginner friendly. Jo's catchphrase is ‘less is more’. Sizes: XS-XXXL A4 / Letter: 27 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages

products.title: Tilda Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: Sometimes girls want to look a little more grown-up. This oversized dress with dropped short sleeves has a stylish collar and handy button closure. The details complete the picture with a yoke, gathers at the front and back, and oh-so-handy hidden side seam pockets. Select the length based on what works for you. We made our Tilda (just below) knee-length. Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU) 0 - 28 (US) 4 - 32 (UK) A4 / Letter: 38 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages This is a Social Sew Along Pattern! Rewatch the Social Sew Along here .

products.title: Milly Top Sewing Pattern
products.body: So many options with Milly. A gorgeous (bra friendly) open back top with a knotted tie and a jewel neckline at the front? A wrap top at the front cinched with a tie? We're imagining Milly made up in a silk or taffeta with a lovely floral or bird print. Check out the sew along of this pattern here ! Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 31 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages

products.title: Micky Bodywarmer Sewing Pattern
products.body: Micky is your unisex go-to for bridging the mid-season gap. When it's still too warm for a coat, this bodywarmer with standing collar and practical snap closure is sure to come in handy. It's up to you whether you add the welt flap pockets and thread elastic through the sleeve trim and hem bands. Sizes: 2 - 14 y A4 / Letter: 24 pages A0 / US format: 1 page

products.title: Meryll Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: Totally now, but with a flourish of folklore. Meryll steals the shows with its charming puff sleeves and ravishing godets. We'll be honest; godets need a little extra effort, but ... they’re totally worth it! The narrow casing, tightened with a fabric tie – or a cord, if you like – gives elegant waist definition. Bias tape is used to deftly finish the round neckline. Last but not least – the back keyhole neckline features an adorable button loop closure. And Magic Meryll is all yours. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 38 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages

products.title: Arielle Jumper Sewing Pattern
products.body: Arielle is a summery jumper for sunny days when there’s a chill in the air. The fun sleeves have a nifty pleat at the shoulders. And all the edges are finished in trim fabric. Arielle fits like a glove and is done in no time, so there's a good chance there are at least two in your future. One in daffodil yellow or bright fuchsia maybe, and another in muted sand? Of course, you could also go for a funky print or stripes. Up to you... Sizes: XS-XXXL A4 / Letter: 22 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages

products.title: Clover Trousers Sewing Pattern
products.body: Say hello to home-sewn workwear. These high-waisted cargo trousers with zip fly are no small feat, but they’re sure to deliver double the satisfaction. Let's start with the easy part – straight legs. Two angled patch pockets go on the front. The side also has a pocket with a pleat and a flap. And the back pockets? Attractively curved. The double rows of topstitching and hammer loop attached to the back pocket complete this cool pattern. Go for it! Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU) 0 - 28 (US) 4 - 32 (UK) A4 / Letter: 43 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages

products.title: Simone Top Sewing Pattern
products.body: Ms Simone is all about the ruffles. This darling blouse features generous tiered ruffles on the bodice and ruffles at the end of the sleeves. Bias tape is used to finish the round neckline. Simone is brilliant as a blouse, but also dazzles as a dress. All you've got to do is lengthen that bottom tier to your heart's desire. “One day I'll fly away...” Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 24 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages

products.title: Doris Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: The right dress can make the day, and Doris will give you immaculate style. The statement sleeves of this simple straight dress with round neckline are sure to turn heads. The sleeves are double layered and the shorter inner sleeve pulls the outer sleeve in, creating a balloon effect. A few other details worth mentioning? Bust darts, a handy slit in the centre back seam for walking comfort … pop the dress over your head and you’re ready to go! The length is up to you, and the belt is optional. Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU) 0 - 28 (US) 4 - 32 (UK) A4 / Letter: 51 pages A0 / US format: 4 pages

products.title: Rachel Bermuda Sewing Pattern
products.body: Bermuda season is here! And Rachel is a simple yet stylish addition to your summer wardrobe. It's fun to make and great to wear. There are handy side seam pockets and turned up hems above the knee. Zip, button – done and dandy. Time to bare those legs! Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU) 0 - 28 (US) 4 - 32 (UK) A4 / Letter: 30 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages

products.title: Nina Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: Nina is a winged beauty with an empire waist. Wow! The back dazzles with a square keyhole,bound at the top with a delicate tie. Every detail counts. The high waistband handsomely gives waist definition and the gathers below the waistband give way to a subtle bell skirt. To top it off, there are side seam pockets to up the practicality factor. Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU) 0 - 28 (US) 4 - 32 (UK) A4 / Letter: 45 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages

products.title: Ermine Blouse Sewing Pattern
products.body: For Ermine, we started with the austere route with simple set-in sleeves, a round neckline, separate button placket, and bias tape for the neckline finish. But then it was impossible not to add a romantic flourish to this blouse! The triangular yoke features sweet gathers at the bottom. Stay understated and make Ermine in a simple solid or turn up the sound with a print explosion. The outfit options are myriad in combination with trousers or a skirt. The more cheerful, the better! Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU) 0 - 28 (US) 4 - 32 (UK)

products.title: Alida Skirt Sewing Pattern
products.body: Oh the Scrabble matches you'd win if you could turn wrap, paperbag, and skirt into a compound word! Wishful thinking aside, this skirt is sure to score you compliments galore. Alida's patch pockets and slit at the front look simultaneously cool and chic. The belt has a fabric covered buckle to boost the paper bag effect at the waist. We made an Alida that ends just below the knee, but of course the length is entirely up to you! Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU) 0 - 28 (US) 4 - 32 (UK) A4 / Letter: 47 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages

products.title: Irma Bodywarmer Sewing Pattern
products.body: Bodywarmers are totally back to the future. This item is HOT – literally and figuratively. Go carefree without a belt or add one for a touch of class. What makes Irma stand out? Sizes: XS-XXXL A4 / Letter: 31 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages

products.title: Giselle Coat Sewing Pattern

Sizes: XS-XXXL A4 / Letter: 49 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages

products.title: Veronica Dress/Jumpsuit Sewing Pattern

products.title: Betty Trousers Sewing Pattern
products.body: Betty is a timeless pair of high-waisted ankle length balloon trousers. products.title: Tanita Top Sewing Pattern
products.body: Have you got time to spare? Then check out this project for a great easy-peasy idea. A nice fabric and elastic trim are all you need. And the result? Simply divine! Now, go have a blast! Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 22 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages

products.title: Clemence Top Sewing Pattern

products.title: Suri Top Sewing Pattern

products.title: Tulia Jumpsuit Sewing Pattern
products.body: Tulia’s lapelled V-neck and roomy ankle-length trousers take you all the way back to the eighties. The pleats that run from front to back show off your shoulders. Skirt lovers, what are you waiting for? Sizes: 32 - 60 (EU) 0 - 28 (US) 4 - 32 (UK) A4 / Letter: 44 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages

products.title: Zita Dress Sewing Pattern

products.title: Minnie Top Sewing Pattern
products.body: Like mother, like daughter… Keen for you and your mini-me to match? Minnie is the perfect pattern – Mabel shrunk down to size! What can we say? It’s perfect for stealing the show at your next garden party… Sizes: 2 -14 years A4 / Letter: 18 pages A0 / US format: 1 page

products.title: Robin Pullover Sewing Pattern

products.title: Viva Dress Sewing Pattern

Viva ... Viva! Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 40 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages

products.title: Mabel Top Sewing Pattern
products.body: A top can make or break your outfit, which is why we're fans of this simple Mabel top with a round neckline and three-quarter length puffed sleeves. products.title: Didi Pullover Sewing Pattern

That’s right – hack me baby, one more time. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 31 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages

Watch the Sew Along here Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 38 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages

products.title: Molly Jacket Sewing Pattern

products.title: Carmen Coat Sewing Pattern

products.title: Paulette Blouse Sewing Pattern

The blouse’s fitted cut has princess seams with ruffles on both sides of the bodice front, extending over the shoulders and around the back. Paulette has an elegant standing collar and a proper shirt cuff! Sizes: 32 - 58 (EU) 0 - 26 (US) 4 - 30 (UK) A4 / Letter: 38 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages

products.title: Blanca Trousers Sewing Pattern

products.title: Rozan Top Sewing Pattern
products.body: This graceful romantic top is destined to have you daydreaming about sunshine and summertime. The elegance is all in the details. The V-neck, set in sleeves with ruffle cuff, and separate button placket make Rozan a true gem. Bring on the summer! Not a fan of that many ruffles? Then leave off the ruffle sleeves and instead extend the sleeves to your preferred length! Sizes: XS -XXXL A4 / Letter: 32 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages

products.title: Ginger Top Sewing Pattern
products.body: This pretty top with simple, basic sleeves is a must for your autumn wardrobe. Ginger is an invitation to freewheelin’ fun! Plus, it’s a snap to lengthen into a dress. products.title: Alix Skirt Sewing Pattern

products.title: Babette Trousers Sewing Pattern

products.title: Debra dress Sewing Pattern

products.title: Adria Jacket Sewing Pattern
products.body: Every season should start with a new jacket. This short oversized jacket with collar and lapels requires some perseverance, but it pays off beautifully in the end. The slash pockets and double-breasted front only add to Adria’s allure. And the tabs at the sleeve hems and decorative topstitching make this pattern look extra on point. Plus, twinning is winning! Have a child in your life? Then make Reese as well for a match made in heaven. Sewing tip - cut the undercollar on the bias Did you know that the undercollar of a coat or jacket is often cut on the bias? This has a very specific reason: The undercollar is smaller than the upper collar. By rotating the grainline 90° and cutting it on the bias, the undercollar becomes more elastic. This prevents it from peeking out on the right side of

products.title: Mary Top Sewing Pattern

products.title: Bay Skirt Sewing Pattern

products.title: Cleo Dress Sewing Pattern

products.title: Faye Dress | Sewing Pattern

products.body: Simple yet special. It’s not that easy to do, but Harper manages it beautifully.This brilliant top has three-quarter sleeves, a round neckline, and wonderful gathers. products.body: Gabriela’s a sweetheart. This short, loose bodywarmer invites you to play with patterns, colour blocking, stripes in different directions… Let your imagination run wild. products.title: Eve Dress Sewing Pattern

products.title: Drea Trench Coat Sewing Pattern
products.body: Singing in the rain, just singing in the rain. Drea makes every dreary day better. But first, some puzzling and patience await you. products.title: Carry Blouse Sewing Pattern

products.title: Salsa Dog Sewing Pattern
products.body: Meet your dog’s new favorite outfit! Salsa is Fibre Mood’s very first dog pattern — fun, comfy, and easy to sew. The perfect way to add style (and warmth) to walks, playdates, or cozy autumn days at home.

products.title: Tiany Top Sewing Pattern (T-Family containing 2 patterns)
products.body: Tiany is part of the C-family. When you purchase this pattern, you will receive the complete pattern bundle, With the pattern content from this family, you can also create the Thalia variation. Tiany is a fitted, sleeveless top with a high, round neckline. The neck and armholes can be finished with piping in the same fabric or with border fabric for a sporty look. This versatile basic should not be missing from your wardrobe: wear it solo or as a layer under a cardigan or blazer. Looking for an eye-catching variant? Then maybe Thalia is just what you are looking for. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 29 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages projector file

products.title: Mirri Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: Mirri is that one dress that really always works: simple, stylish, and oh so versatile. This A-line design with short sleeves and topstitched in-seam pockets is beautifully understated and a true staple for your capsule wardrobe. And the styling? From casual to festive chic – it's entirely up to you. The neckline is neatly finished with bias tape, and the sleeves feature an elegant hem. In short, a timeless must-sew to make and wear time and time again. Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 38 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages projector file

products.title: India Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: A comfortable, midi length dress that you cinch to your liking, with drop shoulders and long, wide sleeves? Sounds like India. The highlight of this piece is undoubtedly the boat neckline with V-opening and cute tie. Ready for even more India love? Just turn her into a trendy top, with long or short sleeves. Bet you can't get enough! Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 52 pages A0 / US format: 3 pages projector file

products.title: Dazzle Top Sewing Pattern
products.body: Dazzle is a cute, loose-fitting top with a trendy polo collar. The wide, short sleeves with sleeve trim and the popular collar make Dazzle a sporty and at the same time classy eye-catcher. This model is also wonderfully versatile and comes into its own in both airy, woven fabrics and knitted ones. Do you love variations? Make Dazzle a little longer and you have a playful dress! Sizes: XS - XXXL A4 / Letter: 34 pages A0 / US format: 2 pages projector file

products.title: Muriel Dress Sewing Pattern
products.body: Let's talk Muriel. This fitted, sleeveless midi dress is a real showstopper. The gathers running from the bust to the slit? Pure magic! The bodice is fitted with elastic, while the skirt features a tie for that eye-catching gathered look. The result? A playful look and a super flattering fit. The channels are made with bias tape, neatly stitched on the wrong side. And last but not least: a concealed zip at the centre back, and a neckline and armholes finished with a facing.
